The Chinese characters for Lauren

As a transliteration, Lauren is usually written 劳伦 (Láo lún). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Lauren comes from Latin and means “laurel (feminine of Laurence)”.

About the name Lauren

A feminine of Laurence that rose with the actress Lauren Bacall.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Lauren suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
